In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the term “psychological stressor” is a general term that refers to a wide range of social, environmental, and interpersonal circumstances that are perceived by individuals as threatening or challenging.
the term psychological stressors is an umbrella concept that encompasses a very large number of different types of environmental situations and events.
psychological stressors are a broad and varied array of environmental exposures that can have noxious psychological and physiological consequences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the study of psychological stressors has been a major and central theme for psychological and behavioral science research for more than a century, and the field is now at a point where a number of key issues are ripe for resolution and clarification, which in turn would lead to a more coherent and unified body of knowledge.
psychological stressors are environmental exposures that challenge the adaptive resources of an organism and, if not adequately managed, can lead to adverse mental or physical health consequences.
psychological stressors are environmental exposures that are perceived as a threat to the organism, that is, they are appraised by the organism as a threat.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the psychological stressor construct is not monolithic, but is comprised of many distinct types of exposures, each with its own specific attributes, characteristics, and qualities.
the stress response is a highly adaptive mechanism that evolved in the context of life-threatening events.
the impact of stressors on health is a function of the stressors themselves as well as the characteristics of the individuals exposed.
